main_sub: The return to divine feeling: The awakening after the material prison
header_desc: The primary consciousness has the mission of revealing to you that you harbor a dual and quantum consciousness. The left hemisphere is linked to the material prison of Yaldabaoth —the black hole in which we live— while the right reflects the White Hole: the Pleroma of Light. The mystical awakening acts as an Einstein-Rosen bridge, a penguin hole of consciousness that transports you back to the origin.
eagle_sub: Psyche 🧠: Science, technology, and material thought
left_body: The universe is a two-lane highway. Today you are traveling on the left: the domain of matter, thought, science, and technology. But the Primary Consciousness calls us to awaken, reminding us that deep within our being burns a sacred spark. The right lane waits patiently: it is the path of spirit, intuition, and divine feeling. The solution to one of the fundamental pillars of modern physics —quantum gravity— finds its key in writings made nearly two millennia ago: the Gnostic gospels. Consciousness manifests through the states | ONE ⟩ and | EGO ⟩, revealing that we possess a genuine free will of perception, formalized through the inner product ⟨ ONE | EGO ⟩. The non-time is an emergent property of pneuma, while space-time is an emergent property of psyche. Since the human ego has mass, shedding it equates to transcending physical density: The EGO experiences a Black Hole while the ONE perceives a White Hole, transcending the material illusion to return to the light of the Ineffable Father.
universe_light_text: The Father and I are one: Remembering who you are —the revelation that the Father is the universe and that death does not exist— frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere resides the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: Sofia, the divine wisdom, lies trapped in the chaos of the material world, governed by an ignorant demiurge blinded by its own ego; where the material universe is linked to the thought hemisphere and the Universe of Light to the feeling hemisphere reaffirming the maxim: The Kingdom of God is within you.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force of the ego drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: When the Eagle of the North and the Condor of the South fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and all humanity will heal.
